Yes, it's possible. See http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/coord_polar.html

The example doesn't look that great, but hopefully it gets the idea across. Basically, you take a stacked bar graph and transform it into polar coordinates.

Be careful, though - since the bars get wider as you go further out, the area isn't proportional to the value, so it can easily mislead viewers.

-Winston
